title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Deciding a Review
content:
## Scope

This page covers the decision the line takes on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance file that is under review. The decision is recorded as one of two outcomes, approved or rejected, and a file that is not in a state to be decided keeps the status under review without any decision being recorded.

## Handling and visible effect

The desk records the decision on the acceptance. Once recorded:

- an approved acceptance shows the status approved and carries the approval date;
- a rejected acceptance shows the status rejected and carries the rejection date.

## Basis Q&A

**Which acceptances does this concern?** Acceptances whose status is under review.

**What decides between approval and rejection?** Whether the goods, as the acceptance and its booking stand at that moment, fit their category.

**Is anything recorded when the file cannot be decided?** No; the acceptance simply remains under review.
